_comment: SDXL + IPAdapter FaceID Plus v2 workflow. REQUIREMENTS: sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors in checkpoints/, ip-adapter-faceid-plusv2_sdxl.bin + ip-adapter-faceid-plusv2_sdxl_lora.safetensors in ipadapter/, CLIP-ViT-bigG-14-laion2B-39B-b160k.bin (or .safetensors) in clip_vision/, insightface + onnxruntime pip packages. Reference image in ComfyUI input/ folder.

2._comment: CLIP Vision ViT-H (1280 dims) — FaceID Plus V2 SDXL needs ViT-H, NOT ViT-bigG (1664 dims). Use CLIP-ViT-bigG only for standard IPAdapter SDXL.

3._comment: Loads the IP-Adapter FaceID model weights

4._comment: InsightFace buffalo_l — extracts face embeddings. Auto-downloads on first use.

5._comment: Reference image containing the face to lock. Place in ComfyUI input/ folder.

6._comment: Positive prompt — describe the new scene/pose, NOT the face identity

inputs.text: same woman, modern city street at night, casual jeans and jacket, rain, neon reflections, cinematic, photorealistic
lowres, bad anatomy, worst quality, blurry, deformed, different person, fantasy armor

9._comment: Applies face identity from reference image. Adjust weight (0.6-0.9) for strength vs prompt adherence.
